headline: Ordinary disability application, retirement applications, and a $6,900,000.00 PRIT fund redemption are on the agenda.
summary: The agenda covers one ordinary disability application, three superannuation applications, and seven retirement allowance calculations. It also includes refunds, redeposits, warrants, survivor benefits, and new members.

Makeup of contributions for Randy Piteo and redeposits for Tatiana Pena, Mark Jenkins, John Rodriguez Jr., and John Toledo
Reaffirm approval of Warrants #75 through #81, including retirement payroll of $8,694,620.24 and PRIT fund redemption of $6,900,000.00

plain_text:
AGENDA FOR THE SPRINGFIELD RETIREMENT BOARD MEETING 
70 TAPLEY STREET, SPRINGFIELD, MA 01104 
TO BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 4, 2026 AT 5:00 P.M.   
 
Agenda Item #1-Minutes 
Vote to consider approving the minutes of the meeting held on October 7, 2026. 
 
Agenda Item #2-Ordinary Disability Application-Dany Dallaire-Water & Sewer Commission 
Vote to consider the responses of the medical panel for the Ordinary Disability benefits submitted 
 by Dany Dallaire. 
 
Agenda Item #3-Superannuation Applications 
Vote to consider the acceptance of the following Superannuation Applications: 
1. Kenneth Backlund, Streets Engineering Foreman, DPW Street & Services with 36 years 
and 1 month as of November 28, 2026. 
2. Frances Haley, Sped Para Educator, School Department with 25 years and 8 months  
as of October 28, 2026. 
3. Darren Labonte, Junior Custodian, School Department with 24 years and 11 months 
as of October 17, 2026.  
 
Agenda Item #4-Superannuation Calculations 
Vote to approve the seven (7) retirement allowance calculations as presented to the Board according to statute. 
 
Agenda Item #5-Redeposit of Refunds and Makeup of Contributions  
Vote to consider the makeup of contributions according to statute: 
1. Randy Piteo, Asst Director of Recreation, Parks Department, for two years and six months of 
employment with the DPW Department. 
Vote to consider the redeposits of contributions according to statute: 
1 Tatiana Pena, Site Coordinator, School Department, for the refund from the Springfield Retirement  
System in 2025. 
2. Mark Jenkins, Senior Analyst, School Department, for the refund from the Springfield Retirement  
System in 2024. 
3. John Rodriguez Jr., Paraprofessional, School Department, for the refund from the Springfield 
Retirement System in 2024. 
4. John Toledo, Paraprofessional, School Department, for the refund from the Springfield Retirement 
System in 2025. 
 
Agenda Item #6-Warrants 
Vote to reaffirm the approval of the following warrants: 
Warrant #75 Refunds in the amount of $2,080.66 
Warrant #76 Refunds in the amount of $164,378.86  
Warrant #77 Expenses in the amount of $1,212.59 
Warrant #78 Transfers in the amount of $231,620.85 
Warrant #79 Refunds in the amount of $97,710.69 
Warrant #80 Expenses in the amount of $95,066.23 
Warrant #81 Retirement payroll in the amount of $8,694,620.24 
and redemption from the PRIT fund in the amount of $6,900,000.00
Agenda Item #7-Refunds/Transfers to Other Systems  
Vote to consider the twenty-five (25) requests for refunds and transfers to other systems as presented to the 
board. The names have been submitted to their particular Department, the Law Department and the 
Massachusetts Department of Revenue. 
 
Agenda Item #8-New Members 
Vote to consider the eighty (80) New Members for membership due to their employment within the member 
units of the Springfield Retirement System as presented to the Board. 
 
Agenda Item #9-Monthly Financial Reports 
Vote to accept the monthly financial reports for the month of September as presented to the Board. 
 
Agenda Item #10-Benefits under Section 12(2)(d)   
Vote to consider survivor benefits to the beneficiary of Paul Lamarre of the School Department-Deceased 
 
Agenda Item #11-Benefits under Section 9  
Vote to consider survivor benefits to the beneficiary of Omer Tavernier, Jr. of the Fire Department-Deceased 
 
Agenda Item #12-Meeting dates for Calendar Year 2027 
Set the meeting dates for 2027. 
 
Agenda Item #13-Director’s Report 
➢ MGL Chapter 32 Section 91A – Excess Earnings/Terminations/Non-Compliance 
➢ MGL Chapter 32 Section 8 - CME Reviews 
 
Agenda Item #14-Attorney’s Report  
 
Agenda Item #15-Old Business 
 
Agenda Item #16-New Business 
 
Reports and Notices 
➢ PERAC Memos 
o 26-FY28 Appropriation Questionnaire in PROSPER 
o 27-Free Cybersecurity Training 
➢ PERAC 2025 Comparative Analysis 
➢ PERAC Pension News 
➢ PTG Correspondence 
➢ PRIT Fund Update – September 
➢ Treasurer’s Reconciliation for the month of September 
➢ Budget Balances as of October 
➢ Monthly Transfers as of October 
➢ Recent Retiree Deaths  
➢ List of Injury Reports 
➢ Monthly Cash Flow 
 
Next Monthly Board Meeting: December 9, 2026 @ 4:00 P.M.
The Board reserves the right to consider items on the agenda out of order. In addition, the Board may enter into 
Executive Session during the meeting if requested by the individual or as deemed necessary by the Board or its 
Legal Counsel.  Items listed for discussion in Executive Session may be conducted in open session in addition 
to or in lieu of discussion in Executive Session.
